card.line: Ramah, meaning "high place," is the name of several towns, and one was Samuel's home, where he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD.

moments.title: Israel asks for a king
moments.text: The elders of Israel came to Samuel at Ramah and asked him to appoint a king like the other nations. The LORD told Samuel they had rejected Him as their king, and Samuel was to warn them.

moments.title: David runs to Samuel
moments.text: David ran from Saul and went to Samuel at Ramah, then they stayed at Naioth. Saul sent messengers, and the Spirit of God came upon them so they spoke for God. Saul came too, and the Spirit came upon him on the way.

moments.title: Samuel is buried
moments.text: When Samuel died, all Israel gathered to mourn for him. They buried him at his home in Ramah.

moments.title: Baasha builds up Ramah
moments.text: Baasha king of Israel built up Ramah with strong walls to keep people from leaving or entering Asa's land. This was probably a different Ramah, in Benjamin. When Baasha stopped, Asa's men carried away the stones and timbers and used them to build Geba and Mizpah.

moments.title: Jeremiah is freed
moments.text: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, found Jeremiah in chains at Ramah among the people being taken away to Babylon. He let Jeremiah go there. After this, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.
